tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch product data for classification: title, description, material composition, country of origin, unit value and currency.

tools.name: search_hs_nomenclature
tools.description: Search HS six-digit subheadings by keywords (material, function, form). Returns candidate codes with official descriptions. Search several phrasings for ambiguous products.

tools.name: calculate_landed_cost
tools.description: Deterministic landed-cost estimate for US or Canada (or OTHER with CIF basis). All rates are inputs supplied by the user or reviewer: duty rate %, tariff surcharge %, import tax % (CA GST/HST). Returns duty, surcharge, US MPF/HMF, import tax, total and per-unit cost in the import currency.

goods_value.description: Total goods value in goods currency

fx_rate.description: Import currency per 1 unit of goods currency

tools.name: submit_for_review
tools.description: Send HS suggestions to the human customs reviewer. Mandatory for every product: no code is ever applied without review.

national_extension_note.description: What decides the US HTSUS 8/10-digit and Canadian 8/10-digit line
